errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the order of the battery types on the x-axis is arbitrary. In fact, they are ordered by generally increasing energy density, from Pb-Acid (lowest) to Solid State (highest).

errors.text_span: измерена в единици, които не са ясно определени, но се предполага, че са в диапазон от 0 до 350
errors.evidence: The phrasing is awkward and conflates the concepts of units and range. The energy density is measured in unspecified units, and the values shown are in the range of 0 to 350. The range itself is not a unit or part of the unit.
